verdict.rationale: Metronome exposes a full programmatic surface (REST API + OpenAPI spec) for subscription lifecycle management (create/upgrade/downgrade/seats), contract creation for credits/commitments, and rate/price overrides for trials and plan changes, with bearer-token authentication and idempotent retries suitable for agentic automation. However, evidence only describes basic bearer-token auth ('create and manage tokens') without documenting granular/scoped permissions (e.g., per-token role or resource scoping), so the 'scoped permissions' half of the story is unconfirmed. Missing for 10: explicit scoped/role-based API token permissions, evidence of least-privilege agent access controls, and independent/hands-on confirmation of an agent successfully executing these billing operations.
